prohibitions: method selection using historical semantic outcomes
scientific_unit: one prospectively sampled safety-conditioned fresh controller
row_estimand: r_i = equal-shell mean of Spearman_j(A0_s(i,j), Dshape_s(i,j)) over the 31 fixed historical references
population_question: whether relational alignment is positive across the population of safety-conditioned fresh controllers
global_effect_summary: equal-shell mean global Spearman over all Kx31 dyads; descriptive/effect-size unless its cluster inference calibrates

methods.test: fresh-row label QAP with fixed reference columns
exact one-sided Binomial test of P(r_i>0)<=0.5
methods.zero_handling: discard exact zeros; p=1 if no nonzero rows

methods.test: one-sample studentized t statistic with df=K-1

methods.bootstrap_unit: complete fresh-controller row coupled across shells

methods.test: fresh-controller CR1 cluster t with df=K-1
methods.retain_only_if: calibrated and power exceeds the selected simpler controller-level method by at least 0.05 at rho-like 0.15

scenarios.description: balanced positive/negative row associations with population mean and sign probability null
safety-conditioned fresh geometry with outcome profiles independent of geometry
balanced heavy-tailed row effects, heteroskedastic rows, and shared item nuisance

calibration.null_pass: empirical rejection <=0.065 and Wilson lower bound <=0.055 for every applicable plausible null
calibration.coverage_pass: two-sided 95% CI coverage >=0.925 where a CI is defined
calibration.bias_report: report signed and absolute bias; no post-hoc bias threshold selects a method
calibration.ties_and_degeneracy: must fail closed; exact-zero rule as method-specific above
calibration.LOFO: report leave-one-fresh-controller-out point-estimate range and decision stability

power_adequacy.preferred: at least 0.60 at both 50%-closed-A0 and rho-like 0.15

selection_precedence: calibrated under every applicable plausible heterogeneity null
direct match to fresh-controller population estimand
selection_rule: Select the first scientifically direct method satisfying all calibration requirements and preferred power; never select a more powerful anti-conservative method. Retain global Kx31 rho descriptively.
